# AI Chat Archive

> AI Chat Archive is a Chrome extension that exports Claude.ai and ChatGPT
> conversations — including uploaded attachments and Claude-generated artifacts — to
> PDF, HTML, or Markdown. It runs entirely in the user's browser; nothing is uploaded
> anywhere. A free tier supports one-off exports with unlimited free PDF; a paid
> license unlocks batch export of every conversation in the account, attachment
> bundling, and Project Export — one ZIP per claude.ai project (Instructions +
> knowledge files + every conversation in the project).

This file follows the [llms.txt proposal](https://llmstxt.org/). For the full concatenated
text of every document in this repository, see [`llms-full.txt`](/llms-full.txt).
